sensor.name: CUST - Symantec SEP Client Virus Definitions Revision Friendly
sensor.description: Custom SEP sensor to make definition format more user friendly.

sensor_query.query:
'==================================== ' Symantec Endpoint Protection ' ' Get Client's Virus Defs Revision '====================================
'@INCLUDE=lib/symantec/IsSepInstalled.vbs '@INCLUDE=lib/symantec/GetSepVersion.vbs '@INCLUDE=lib/symantec/GetOsArchitecture.vbs '@INCLUDE=lib/symantec/GetRegistryProvider.vbs
Option Explicit
WScript.Echo GetAvDefsRev
Function GetAvDefsRev If IsSepInstalled = "False" Then WScript.Echo "Not Installed" WScript.Quit End If If Left(GetSepVersion, 4) = "11.0" Then WScript.Echo "Not Supported" WScript.Quit End If Const HKLM = &H80000002 Dim strPath, dtmVirusDefsDate, dtmVirusDefsRev, intVirusDefsRev, RevDate, objReg : Set objReg = GetRegistryProvider If GetOsArchitecture = "x64-based PC" Then strPath = "SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Symantec\Symantec Endpoint Protection\CurrentVersion\public-opstate" Else strPath = "SOFTWARE\Symantec\Symantec Endpoint Protection\CurrentVersion\public-opstate" End If objReg.GetStringValue HKLM, strPath, "LatestVirusDefsDate", dtmVirusDefsDate objReg.GetDwordValue HKLM, strPath, "LatestVirusDefsRevision", dtmVirusDefsRev If Len(dtmVirusDefsRev) = 1 Then intVirusDefsRev = Right("00" & dtmVirusDefsRev, 3) ElseIf Len(dtmVirusDefsRev) = 2 Then intVirusDefsRev = Right("0" & dtmVirusDefsRev, 3) Else intVirusDefsRev = dtmVirusDefsRev End If
RevDate=split(dtmVirusDefsDate,"-")
GetAvDefsRev = Replace(dtmVirusDefsDate, "-", "", 1, -1, 1) & "|" & intVirusDefsRev & "|" & RevDate(2)+"/"+RevDate(1)+"/"+RevDate(0) & "|" & DateDiff("d",RevDate(2)+"/"+RevDate(1)+"/"+RevDate(0),Date)
'GetAvDefsRev = Replace(dtmVirusDefsDate, "-", "", 1, -1, 1) & "|" & DateDiff("d",dtmVirusDefsDate,year(now)*100+month(now)*100+day(now)) End Function 'GetAvDefsRev '------------ INCLUDES after this line. Do not edit past this point ----- '- Begin file: lib/symantec/IsSepInstalled.vbs ' Returns True or False if SEP is installed
Function IsSepInstalled Dim colItems : Set colItems = GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2").ExecQuery("Select Status from Win32_Service where Name = 'SepMasterService' or Name = 'Symantec AntiVirus'") If colItems.Count = 0 Then IsSepInstalled = "False" Else IsSepInstalled = "True" End If Set colItems = Nothing End Function 'IsSepInstalled '- End file: lib/symantec/IsSepInstalled.vbs '- Begin file: lib/symantec/GetSepVersion.vbs 'Returns the version of SEP client installed.
Function GetSepVersion Const HKLM = &H80000002 Dim strVersion, strPath, objReg : Set objReg = GetRegistryProvider If GetOsArchitecture = "x64-based PC" Then strPath = "SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Symantec\Symantec Endpoint Protection\CurrentVersion" Else strPath = "SOFTWARE\Symantec\Symantec Endpoint Protection\CurrentVersion" End If objReg.GetStringValue HKLM, strPath, "PRODUCTVERSION", strVersion GetSepVersion = strVersion Set objReg = Nothing End Function 'GetSepVersion '- End file: lib/symantec/GetSepVersion.vbs '- Begin file: lib/symantec/GetOsArchitecture.vbs ' Returns the architecture of the OS ' "x64-based PC" or "x86-based PC"
Function GetOsArchitecture Dim objItem, colItems : Set colItems = GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2").ExecQuery("Select SystemType from Win32_ComputerSystem") For Each objItem In colItems GetOsArchitecture = objItem.SystemType Next Set colItems = Nothing End Function '- End file: lib/symantec/GetOsArchitecture.vbs '- Begin file: lib/symantec/GetRegistryProvider.vbs
Function GetRegistryProvider Dim intArch, objCtx, objLocator, objServices, objRegProv If GetOsArchitecture = "x64-based PC" Then intArch = 64 Else intArch = 32 End If Set objCtx = CreateObject("WbemScripting.SWbemNamedValueSet") objCtx.Add "__ProviderArchitecture", intArch Set objLocator = CreateObject("Wbemscripting.SWbemLocator") Set objServices = objLocator.ConnectServer("","root\default","","",,,,objCtx) Set objRegProv = objServices.Get("StdRegProv") Set GetRegistryProvider = objRegProv Set objCtx = Nothing Set objLocator = Nothing End Function 'GetRegistryProvider '- End file: lib/symantec/GetRegistryProvider.vbs
